newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Sitcars Funding's US$83 mln notes AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Sitcars Funding's US$83 mln notes AAA.

text.p: Standard & Poors said on Friday it has assigned a AAA rating to Sitcars Funding Ltd's US$83 million passthrough auto hire purchase receivables-backed notes.
Sitcars Funding is a special purpose company located in the Cayman Islands. The proceeds will ultimately flow to originators Sitca Investment and Securitites Plc Co Ltd and Sitca Leasing Co Ltd.

The flow will be channelled via yen loans and Thai baht notes and loans, through two intermediary special purpose companies incorporated in Thailand, Sitca SPV Ltd and Sitca Leasing SPV Ltd. Swap agreements with ING Bank NV, which is rated AA-minus, mitigate currency risks, the rating agency said.
The rating of Sitcars Funding's notes reflects the note policy provided by MBIA Inc's unit MBIA Insurance Corp.

The insurance firm, whose claims-paying ability is rated AAA, guarantees the full and timely payment of interest due on the quarterly payment dates and the full repayment of principal no later than April 2002, the final maturity date of the notes, it said.

While the average credit quality of Thailand's financial sector has deteriorated in the past year, the Sitca group's hire purchase portfolio performance has remained relatively steady, the rating agency said.
This can be attributed mainly to the group's low level of originations and the company's strategy to consolidate and build a solid platform for future growth, it said.
